pr_title: don't attempt to set cursor relative position for zero sized nodes
pr_body:
# Objective

fix #12007

## Solution

when node size is zero on either axis, set `RelativeCursorPosition::normalized` to None.

issue_context.title: Interactivity regression in bevy_ui
comments: It seems that the issue isn't just with the hidden elements. It seems like I am getting a "ghost" interactive region in the top left corner of the window (size seem to match the absolutely positioned container of the original element). This is weird, in the sense that the interactive region also seem to appear at the correct position, so I can drag my floating panel from the corner and from it's own handle.

I can confirm that I have run into this as well. As soon as I spawn hidden nodes Bevy registers spurious `Interaction`s and `RelativeCursorPosition::mouse_over` returns true where there shouldn't be any node. I was relying on correct `Interaction`s to filter out clicks on entities under UI nodes, so that only UI buttons would be clicked / interacted with, but when upgrading to 0.13 it broke.

review_comments: A comment on this line explaining why this is needed (maybe with a link to this PR) would be great.
